summary: SOBR Safe, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a warrant inducement agreement with holders of existing Series C and D warrants to exercise for cash 2,360,648 common shares at $1.30 per share in exchange for new Series E and F warrants covering 4,721,296 shares at the same strike. Gross proceeds were ~$3.1M. H.C. Wainwright acted as placement agent. The transaction is a structured equity financing to raise working capital, not a transformative M&A event. No board recommendation, premium, or strategic review is present. This is a routine capital-raising tactic, not a special situation.
